title: Ing Talapagdala da ring Siyam a Tanda
intro: Metung a pigura ing tinalakad ibat keng peka mababa a umpisa, a maki kapalaran a makasulat keng banal a kaburian. Makatago ya keng kayanakan at meragul ya kilub ning pader ning mismung pekapun a magnasang siran no reng memalen na, ing kaladwa ayni meyaus ya keng metung a masikan a misyun. Ala lang kasangkapan nung e ing kasalpantayanan at ing mapagpakumbaba nang pastul, tinalakad la king arap ning pekamasikan a pekapun ning panaun at inawad da ing kalayan para karing me-alipan. Ing yatu mismu balamu kikimut ya keng karelang utus — ding danum mepitna la, ding banua migsalita la, at ing metung a kayarian mesira ya.
clues: Ing mumunang aldo ku mitatakan ya keng takut — deng anak a kalupa ku meyakit la keng pangabait na ning alang lunus a manimuna na tatakut keng hinaharap.
Linigtas na ku ning danum at peparagul na ku kilub ning palasyu ning mismung pekapun a manintun king kanakung pangasira.
Tinakas ku king kanakung tibuan kaybat ning biglang milyari, meging mapagpakumbaba kung pastul king marayung bansa.
Mibalik ku ban arapan ke itang mayupayang manungkulan a maki simpling tukud at malino a mensahi, a maniawad king kalayan da ring kanakung memalen.
Binie ke ing maragul a danum para kareng tinuki kanaku, at linawe ku kabang ding danum a reti linasun de ing kalaban ku.
kinuldas ku keng sagradung bunduk para tanggapan ing banal a patnube ibat kang Allah, at mirinan kung siyam a malino tanda bilang patune ning katutwan.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
